prompt: Fixed overhead camera, locked in place; claw and heap remain frozen exactly as framed. In the first instant the red-roofed white house plummets out of frame centre like a dropped stone and lands hard on the heap below. The eave corner bites into the coins, the house tips over onto its side with a sharp jolt, and the impact knocks one gold coin and a small blue house a few millimetres aside. Everything settles at once and the house lies still, wedged at an angle among the coins, for the rest of the shot. Normal playback speed. Sound: one crisp plastic clatter, two coins ringing as they shift, then only the low whir of the claw motor.
